notes.title: Your First Match in UFL on PC — Demo Test Kicks Off on June 9

The world of football gamers will unite on June 9 for [b]UFL’s Demo Test on PC[/b] — a large-scale two-week event where everyone can try UFL out ahead of its official release.

This is more than just an open demo test. It’s your chance to play your first matches in UFL and contribute to the development of the project.

[h1]What Awaits You in the Demo Test?
[/h1]
[list]
[*] Early Access to UFL — play before the release
[*] Online leagues and matches with players from around the world
[*] Licensed footballers and a well-thought-out club management system
[*] A chance to give feedback and shape the game’s future
[*] A Commemorative Badge for playing 5 matches in any mode
[/list]
[h2]Commemorative Badge
[/h2]
As a token of appreciation for participating in the Demo Test, we’ve got a special reward for you — a commemorative badge that will make you stand out on the pitch. It will be available after the official release.

This badge will be a mark of honor, showing that you were among the first to try UFL before its launch and contributed to shaping the game during the testing phase.

[h3]Important to Know
[/h3]
After the Demo Test ends, all progress will be reset — clubs, squads, and achievements will not carry over.

[h2]UFL: A New Take on Football Simulations
[/h2]
UFL is being built from the ground up as a fair, competitive, and free-to-play experience where your skills are key.

We’re inviting you to be part of the journey from the very beginning!

[h2]Minimum System Requirements
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
[*] OS: Windows 10 - 64bit
[*] Processor: Processor AMD Ryzen 7 2700X or Intel Core i7 6700K
[*] Memory: 12 GB RAM
[*] Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT or Nvidia GeForce GTX 1650
[*] Network: Broadband Internet connection
[/list]
[h2]We’re Building UFL Together
[/h2]
This is more than a test. We will be gathering feedback, checking the game balance and scrutinizing the server infrastructure.

Every opinion you share helps improve the game.

The build download becomes available from [b]June 6 at 12:00 UTC[/b]. Servers will go live on [b]June 9 at 07:00 UTC[/b] and remain open until [b]June 16 at 23:59 UTC[/b]. From [b]June 9 to 16[/b], you won’t be just playing — you’ll be actively shaping UFL’s development!

[h3]Need Help?

If you experience any technical issues while installing or playing UFL, please visit our [b][url=https://support.uflgame.com/]Support Portal[/url][/b].
You can submit requests and report issues directly on the main page.

[b]Your Feedback Matters

We’re committed to building UFL with you — every update is shaped by your input and passion.
Thank you for being a part of this journey. Let’s keep moving forward — together.

notes.title: Behind the Scenes: Adapting UFL for PC Players
notes.notes:
Bringing UFL to PC is far more than a simple port from consoles. It’s a full-scale adaptation process involving new discoveries and a firm commitment to delivering a high-quality experience for all our players.

[h3]Diving into PC Gaming[/h3]

When we set out to develop the PC version, we faced multiple challenges right from the start: optimising the game for a wide range of hardware setups, adapting the control schemes, and ensuring that every player could enjoy a smooth and comfortable experience, no matter how they choose to play.

Insights gathered following our closed beta test revealed that [b]around 85% of PC players prefer to play UFL with a gamepad[/b]. Still, we made a key decision to introduce [b]full keyboard and mouse support[/b].

We want everyone to find a play style that suits them best, so we’ve put significant effort into ensuring UFL feels responsive, fair, and comfortable across both control types.

[h3]Security First
[/h3]
We’d also like to highlight that the PC version features a built-in [b]anti-cheat system[/b]. We firmly believe that honest competition is the foundation of a true football simulator.

[h3]What’s Next?
[/h3]
Development of the PC version is ongoing! We’re continuously gathering player feedback, conducting internal tests, and working on performance enhancements. Plus, we’ve got some exciting announcements in the pipeline — stay tuned!

notes.title: Getting Started in UFL: Team Pass
notes.notes:
The [b]Team Pass[/b] in UFL is a football-themed version of the classic battle pass mechanic. It's designed to provide players with [b]exclusive in-game rewards and experiences throughout the season. [/b]Unlike traditional linear reward tracks, UFL’s Team Pass features a more advanced structure that encourages players to engage deeply with the game.

[b][h2]What does it consist of?
[/h2][/b]
The Team Pass is divided into pages. Each page contains various rewards that players can unlock as they interact with the Team Pass. These rewards include in-game currency, performance boosts, and customization items like kits, boots, skin packs, and even footballers.

The pass activates during [b]limited activation time throughout the season[/b], following these principles:
[list]
[*] Team Passes are active for a limited time and are synchronized across different regions.
[*] When the Team Pass activates, the following elements become available:
[/list]
[olist]
[*] The Team Pass interface and its rewards.
[*] Challenges in the challenge system related to the Team Pass.
[*] Options to [b]purchase Team or Elite Pass access.[/b]
[/olist]
[list]
[*] Players can also upgrade from Team to Elite access for an additional fee, with the cost adjusted to reflect the value of the Team Pass they already purchased.
[/list]
[b][h2]Do You Need the Team Pass?
[/h2][/b]
While it's not mandatory, [b]the Team Pass offers a unique way for players to earn exclusive content. [/b]You can either play without it and still enjoy UFL’s core experience, or [b]purchase the Team Pass (or Elite Pass) to unlock additional content and rewards. [/b]By purchasing the enhanced version, such as the Elite Pass, you’ll receive significantly more benefits than playing without it.

[b][h2]What advantages does it offer?[/h2][/b]
While the Team Pass is active, some Challenges will award players with a new resource called "Star Points." Both Team and Elite passes grant Star points upon purchase, but the Elite version offers more. These points unlock new pages and claim rewards, creating a continuous sense of progression.

The Team Pass rewards are divided into pages. Players unlock [b]Page 1 by default[/b], and subsequent pages require a certain number of Star points to access them. The system ensures that players advance based on accumulated Star points, regardless of how they’ve spent them on rewards.

[b][h2]Additionally:[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Some rewards are only available to users who have purchased a Team or Elite Pass.
[*] Players can only purchase each reward on a page once.
[*] [b]Any unspent Stars are lost at the end of the Team Pass period[/b], and a new Star counter begins for the next Team Pass.
[*] A new page can be unlocked by earning Star Points and obtaining all the rewards on the previous page.
[/list]
[b][h2]What Rewards Does the Team Pass Offer?
[/h2][/b]
The Team Pass includes exclusive rewards like custom kits, badges, and other cosmetic items. [b]These rewards are purely cosmetic and do not affect gameplay.[/b] Whether you unlock basic or premium rewards, your success on the field remains skill-based, in line with UFL's philosophy of fair play and no pay-to-win mechanics.

[b][h2]How to get it?
[/h2][/b]
When the Team Pass becomes active, players can access it via the Team Pass interface. There are two purchasing options: [b]Team and Elite[/b]. These passes offer different levels of rewards, and players can upgrade from Team to Elite at any time during the active period at a reduced cost, reflecting the price of the Team Pass already purchased.

notes.title: Getting started in UFL: Division System in UFL
notes.notes:
UFL features a seasonal system where players progress through divisions by competing against other users.

[h2][b]Seasons and Timeframes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Each season has clearly defined timeframes with predetermined start and end dates.
[*] Seasons launch consecutively—each new season begins immediately after the previous one ends.
[*] Opponent matchmaking closes 20 minutes before the season ends to ensure accurate final calculation
[/list]
[h2][b]Division Structure[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] All players begin their first season in the lowest division and gradually progress up.
[*] The ladder is divided into leagues (Bronze, Silver, etc.) and divisions within those leagues (e.g., Bronze 1, Bronze 2).
[*] The division structure is uneven but always progresses from the lowest tier to the Premier Division.
[/list]
[h2][b]Division Progression[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Progression within a division is divided into steps. 
[*] Each victory moves the club up a step, while a loss drops the club down a step. 
[*] A draw does not affect the club's position. 
[*] For example, a player at the top of the division (step 10 out of 10) will move back to 9/10 after a loss.
[/list]
[h2][b]Moving Up a Division[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] For the first promotion in a season, the player receives a one-time reward. The higher the division, the greater the reward.
[*] A win at the top position starts a win streak and counts as the first victory in that streak (10/10 + 1 WS).
[*] If the player is already on a win streak (e.g., 10/10 + 1 WS), a win increases the streak (10/10 + 2 WS).
[*] Completing the win streak promotes the player to the next division.
[*] If the player loses or draws during the win streak, they revert to (10/10).
[*] [b]In lower divisions, win streaks are disabled,[/b] meaning a victory at the top position immediately promotes the player to the next division.
[/list]
[h2][b]Moving Down a Division[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] If a player is at the bottom position of their division, a loss triggers a loss streak.
[*] The first loss initiates the streak, and completing it relegates the player to a lower division.
[*] A win or draw breaks the loss streak, returning the player to the lower boundary of their current division.
[*] In the lowest division, loss streaks do not exist—players cannot drop any lower.
[*] After being relegated, the player starts at the top position of the new division (e.g., 10/10) and can either begin a win streak (if available) or continue progressing up.
[/list]
[h2][b]Matchmaking[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Opponent selection is based on several criteria:

[olist]
[*] The player’s current division.
[*] Ping to the opponent.
[*] Time spent in the matchmaking queue.
[/olist]
[*] The system prioritizes finding opponents within the same division.
[*] If no suitable opponent is found within a certain period, the matchmaking criteria are broadened.
[/list]
[h2][b]Win Streaks in Divisions[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] If a player [b]wins multiple matches in a row[/b], they receive [b]bonus progression[/b] within their division.
[*] While the win streak continues, each subsequent victory grants multiple [b]progression steps[/b] (including win streak bonuses).
[*] Promotion to a new division [b]does not reset the win streak[/b], allowing players to climb faster with a successful match streak.
[/list]
[h2][b]Player Redistribution[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] At the end of each season, all [b]players are redistributed[/b] into the starting divisions of the new season, [b]considering the division they finished in.[/b]
[*] At this point, [b]rewards are distributed[/b] to clubs for their achievements in the previous season.
[/list]
[h2][b]Play, Win, and Climb the Ranks![/b][/h2]
Every season is a new challenge! Sharpen your skills, compete against top opponents, rise to the highest divisions, and earn well-deserved rewards. Show what you're capable of in UFL!

notes.title: Getting Started in UFL: Reputation.
notes.notes:
[h3][b]General Mechanics[/b][/h3]
The reputation system in UFL affects the player acquisition process. It works based on a capacity system, which consists of two elements: basic capacity and enhanced capacity. These two components form the overall reputation meter.

Players on the transfer market are divided into three categories:
[list]
[*] [b]Other Players [/b]– Require soft currency and occupy part of the club's reputation capacity. The higher the player's basic rating, the more capacity is required. The cost of capacity increases exponentially.
[*] [b]Free Agents[/b] – Do not require CP and do not occupy reputation capacity. They can be freely added and removed from the club.
[*] [b]Loan Players [/b]– Require CP for a loan but do not affect the club's reputation capacity. However, there is a match limit (9 matches).
[/list]
[h3][b]Club Reputation[/b][/h3]
Club reputation consists of two parts: basic capacity and enhanced capacity. Each part changes based on the player's actions.

[h3][b]Basic Capacity[/b][/h3]
Basic capacity is automatically granted to the club upon its creation. This value is sufficient to acquire a captain. You can increase basic capacity in the following ways:

[list]
[*] Reaching a specific division (e.g., advancing to Division X for the first time).
[*] Participating in online activities.
[/list]
Basic capacity does not decrease between seasons or events.

[h3][b]Enhanced Capacity[/b][/h3]
Enhanced capacity is a dynamic parameter that can be increased through specific actions in the game. However, it may partially decrease over time.

[h3][b]How to Gain Enhanced Capacity:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Completing matches in Ranked mode and Showdown. The amount of reputation depends on the match result (win, draw, loss).
[*] Using reputation boosters, which increase earned reputation by a certain percentage.
[*] Completing daily and special challenges.
[*] Getting rewards for completing the Team Pass.
[/list]
[h3][b]How Enhanced Capacity Decreases:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Weekly capacity deductions ("club maintenance tax"). Users receive notifications about these deductions. If a player remains inactive, the available capacity gradually decreases to zero; however, the basic capacity level remains unchanged.
[/list]
If the club's total reputation exceeds the current capacity (basic + enhanced), no penalties are applied, and users can still participate in matches and other modes.

[h3][b]Buying Players with Reputation[/b][/h3]
Regular (free and loan) players on the transfer market have a cost in soft currency and occupy a certain amount of the club's reputation capacity. Each player takes a portion of the capacity progress bar. If the capacity is filled, purchasing new players becomes unavailable until additional capacity is freed.

[h3][b]How to Free Capacity:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Increase basic or enhanced capacity.
[*] Sell current club players.
[/list]
Players who cannot be purchased due to insufficient capacity are visually marked with a dimmed price. Additionally, if the "hide unavailable" filter is enabled, they do not appear in the list.

When selling a player on the transfer market, users receive part of the player's value in soft currency, and the corresponding amount of reputation capacity is freed. The same occurs when a player is compensated.

[h3][b]Capacity Cost Rebalance:[/b][/h3]
If the capacity cost for players on the transfer market changes, their individual reputation capacity is recalculated. If, after recalculating, the total player capacity exceeds the club's available reputation capacity, no penalties will be applied, but purchasing new players will be impossible until free capacity is increased.

notes.title: Getting Started in UFL: What is the Showdown Mode?
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce that the new PVP mode, Showdown, which will be available on weekends!
Showdown mode is completely free to access.
This is your chance to test your skills in competitive matches and earn valuable rewards!

[h2]What is the Showdown Mode?[/h2]

Showdown is a new game mode available from Friday evening until Sunday midnight.
Players compete using their current online clubs, with matchmaking based on their match history and current division.

[h2]Participation Requirements:[/h2]

Special tokens are required to enter. You can earn these by completing ranked matches or by having an active premium status.

Each participant has a maximum of 15 matches to play. The goal is to win as many as possible.

[h2]Key Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Each victory unlocks better rewards. You can only claim the reward unlocked when the event ends.
[*] The mode will automatically end when the timer expires, but you’ll still be able to claim your reward the next time you log in or open the event window.
[*] If you lose 5 matches, the event ends early, and you’ll receive the reward corresponding to your current progress.
[*] Draws don’t affect the results and aren’t counted in the overall mechanics.
[/list]
[h2]Why Should You Join?[/h2]
Players who achieve a perfect streak of 15 consecutive wins without any losses will receive a special reward!

notes.title: Getting Started in UFL: Skin Packs
notes.notes:
[h2][b]What is a Skin Pack?[/b][/h2]

A skin pack is a virtual container that holds card skins for your players. These skins can vary in rarity: uncommon, rare, epic, and legendary. Each skin changes the appearance of your player card and might also boost their performance.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/zWKFG8VS/image-9-1.png[/img]

[b][h2]Why You Need a Card Skin[/h2][/b]

[b]1. Skin Packs Boosting Player Performance[/b]
Personal skins improve the attributes of a player. They can also increase the experience he earns from matches, boost existing skills, or add new ones.
There are also skin series. When collected together in a set (in other words, when you apply skins from the same series to several players in your team), they provide additional bonuses to the players you apply them to. The more cards in the set, the bigger their bonus.                        

[b]2. Personalization and Aesthetics[/b]
Skins allow you to customize the appearance of your player cards. You can create a unique team with different skin series or personal skins. This makes the game more engaging and visually appealing. After all, everyone has their own individual vision and tastes.                  

[b]3. Collecting and Prestige[/b]
Collecting skins of greater rarities is an exciting activity that adds an element of thrill to the game. This gives you the opportunity to create a unique collection of the rarest skins of your favorite players.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/C5zWTzh5/SKINS-SQUAD-9-new.png[/img]

[b]How Do Probability Mechanics Work?
[/b]
Each skin inside a skin pack has a certain chance of dropping. These probabilities are usually fixed to their rarity and value within a particular pack.

Next to each skin pack, you can see the number of skins and the drop rates for each skin type. The "die roll" happens every time a skin in the skin pack opens. If a skin pack contains multiple skins, the die roll occurs before each skin opens.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/5hvnqrFF/SKINS-STORE-4-new.png[/img]

[b]How Do Probability Mechanics Work Within Skin Categories?
[/b]
Each skin pack has a certain number of slots.

Each slot in the skin pack has an independent probability. When a slot opens, the first roll determines the skin's rarity. The second roll selects a series of skins or a personal skin type. The third roll determines the player's position for the skin series, and for personal skins, it selects the specific player for whom the skin will be awarded.     

[img]https://i.ibb.co/5XyNMcgv/SKINS-UNPACK-1-new.png[/img]

Understanding these mechanics helps us appreciate why it’s so important to collect skins and also the strategic advantages that rare and powerful skins can bring.

We recommend you follow official announcements from Strikerz Inc. or other official UFL news sources for the most accurate and up-to-date information.

notes.title: Getting Started in UFL: Player card skin system
notes.notes:
Player card skins are customizations that allow users to personalize their gaming experience. These skins include flashy new designs as well as retro styles, each adding its own unique flair to the game. Collecting card skins from the same series provides gameplay benefits, giving your team a competitive edge while enhancing their visual appeal. In this article, we'll explore the mechanics of UFL player card skin customization, highlight its advantages, and provide some instructions.

[b]Card Skin Series
[/b]
We have implemented a mechanic enabling users to receive bonuses for using card skins from the same series. While skins from the same series can look similar, they may have different rarities. Things to consider:
[list]
[*] Series bonuses only work when player skins are equipped on the Starting XI.
[*] Users can collect and use several Skin Series together and, therefore, stack up several bonuses simultaneously. 
[/list]
To apply bonuses from the Skin Series, you need to take the following details into consideration:
[list]
[*] The first bonus applies when you acquire three skins of the same series. The second and third bonuses apply with 5 and 8 skins in your collection, respectively.
[*] When you raise the series tier, the bonuses from previous tiers persist.
[*] Skin Series Bonuses are applied to groups by role. For example, the Attacking Line (LW, RW, ST), the Midfield Line (CAM, CM, CDM), the Defense Line (CB, RB, LB), and the Goalkeeper.
[/list]
[b]Card skin rarities[/b]

Skins come in four levels of rarity: 
[list]
[*] Uncommon
[*] Rare
[*] Epic
[*] Legendary
[/list]
There are a few key points to remember about skin rarity: the bonus the player receives is directly related to the skin rarity. Higher rarity skins provide greater bonuses. Bonuses are tiered, with a maximum rating of four stars.

[b]Combinations & Skin Series
[/b]
Various skin series provide different abilities for player groups, such as ATK, MID, and DEF. Combine several skin series to craft a unique, personalized setup that boosts your preferred tactics. For instance, you could tailor performance on the field by pairing the ATK bonuses of one series (shot power, strength and stamina for your attacking players enhanced), with the DEF bonuses from another series (ball control, crossing and defensive positioning for your defenders improved). With countless combinations to explore, players can genuinely implement their visions and add a personal touch to their clubs. Experiment. Implement. Improve.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/60FgsVyK/pack2-1.png[/img]

[b]Personal Card Skins
[/b]
Besides skin sets, we offer personal skins, which are strictly tied to one footballer and can only be used on that footballer. These skins are marked with a specific colour and have unique visual appearances, animations, and/or shapes.

They can also give various bonuses, such as 
[list]
[*] [b]Footballer stat improvement[/b] – increases the specific stats of that footballer.
[*] [b]Main squad stat improvement [/b]– increases the stats of all footballers in the main squad.
[*] [b]Meta parameter improvement[/b] – increases various bonuses, such as the percentage/amount of Experience a specific footballer receives per match, Energy recovery rate, or Energy consumption rate of that footballer.
[*] [b]Skill improvement [/b]– affects a specific footballer, and increases the skill level specified in the personal skin bonus.
[/list][list][*] [b]If the footballer does not have such a skill, then the skin adds the skill to the footballer skills list.[/b]
[*] [b]Without a skin the skill level returns to its original value.[/b]
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/5gfmNPBD/personal2.png[/img]

[b]How to get Card skins[/b]

To acquire skins, navigate to the "Skins" section in the Main Screen and proceed to the "Store". In the Skins section, you can choose from multiple packs, each offering a variety of skins.

Skins can be purchased using Credits (CP) or League Points (LP). Note that only the Basic Pack can be purchased using only CP, while the rest can be bought with LP. Each pack contains a number of skins, indicated in the description. Skins that a player will obtain in each pack are random, but their rarity is determined by probabilities that can also be found in the description. 

Additionally, skin packs can be obtained as rewards in in-game activities such as Challenges, Team Pass and Showdown games.

In summary, card skins enhance your football experience by giving you bonuses and allowing you to customize your team’s appearance. Collecting skins lets you personalize your team and adds excitement to gameplay. So, dive in, explore the options, and let your style shine through on the pitch!

notes.title: Getting Started in UFL: In-game currency
notes.notes:
UFL features two main types of in-game currency: [b]LP (League Points)[/b] and [b]CP (Credit Points)[/b]. These currencies are essential for customizing your squad, purchasing items, and enhancing your gameplay experience. 

[h3][b]1. Types of In-Game Currency

[/b][/h3][b]LP (League Points)[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]LP [/b]is the hard currency in UFL. It can be used to purchase premium items and enhance your gaming experience.
[/list]
[b]CP (Credit Points)[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]CP[/b] is the soft currency. It is easier to earn and is used for general customizations and in-game items.
[/list]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Twz0K7Wb/1920x1080-Pub-art.png[/img]
[h3][b]2. How to Earn LP and CP

[/b][/h3][b]How to get LP:[/b]
[list]
[*] Earn it by buying the Team Pass.
[*] Earn it by completing Daily and Weekly Challenges.
[*] Purchase in the in-game store.
[/list]
[b]How to get CP:[/b]
[list]
[*] Earn it by playing Ranked Matches.
[*] Earn it by completing Daily and Weekly Challenges.
[*] Purchase it in the in-game store.
[/list]
[h3][b]3. How to spend your LP and CP in UFL
[/b][/h3]
[b]Use your LP to buy:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Customization Items: [/b]Buy custom kits, boots, balls, gloves, badges, and stadiums.
[*] [b]Skin Packs: [/b]Buy skin packs, including card skins for players of any rating.
[*] [b]Boosters: [/b]Buy Premium Boosters, RP Boosters, CP Boosters, and XP Boosters to enhance your in-game performance.
[*] [b]Team Pass: [/b]Use LP to purchase the Team Pass, which grants exclusive rewards.
[*] [b]Open Slots:[/b] Purchase empty player slots for your squad.
[/list]
[b]Use your CP to buy:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Customization Items: [/b]Buy custom kits, boots, balls, gloves, badges.
[*] [b]Skin Packs: [/b]Acquire various skin packs to customize your squad’s appearance.
[*] [b]Energy Recovery: [/b]Spend CP to help your footballers recover their physical condition faster.
[*] [b]Loan Updates: [/b]Use CP for the first update of available loan players each day; updating again on the same day will require LP.
[*] [b]Player Acquisition: [/b]Buy players in the transfer market using CP.
[/list]

[h3][b]4. In-game Items and their effects
[/b][/h3]
[b]Boosters[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]CP Booster: [/b]Increases the amount of CP earned per match.
[*] [b]RP Booster:[/b] Increases the amount of RP earned per match.
[*] [b]XP Booster:[/b] Increases the experience points (XP) a player earns from each match, helping them improve their ratings faster.
[*] [b]Premium Booster: [/b]Improves both XP and CP earnings during matches.
[/list]
[b]Skin Packs[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Basic, Collector’s, Deluxe, Grand, Unique, Super:[/b] Provide player card skins of different rarities for your squad.
[/list]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/CLQ1k3x9/Skin-packs-LP.png[/img]
[b]Player Card Skins[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary, Personal: [/b]Obtain different types of player card skins for your squad, each of different rarity and benefits.
[/list]
[b]Customization Items[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Badges, kits, balls, boots, gloves: [/b]These items enhance your squad's visual appeal and customization.
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/21QJGCBK/Kits-CP.png[/img]
[b]Stadiums[/b]
[list]
[*] Access and purchase new stadiums using in-game currency.
[/list]
[b]Open Slots
[/b][list]
[*] Expand your squad by purchasing additional player slots.
[/list]
In UFL, these currencies are how you build your dream team and customize your gaming experience. Whether you’re looking to invest time or money to accelerate your progress, CP and LP offer valuable ways to enhance your journey in the game.

notes.title: Getting Started in UFL: Players Management
notes.notes:
Managing your team’s Energy is crucial to maintaining peak performance throughout the match. Let’s start with Energy: 

[h3]Energy management: [/h3]
Energy represents the physical condition of your players during a match. Energy is displayed on a white scale ranging from 0 to 100. 

Due to their efforts on the pitch, all players' energy levels decrease after a match. They will gradually recover during rest periods between matches.

[h3]Off-field recovery:[/h3]
Players placed on the bench or in reserve gradually increase their energy levels over time. Each match spent out of the first team contributes to their recovery. 

[h3]Instant recovery: [/h3]
To recover energy instantly, you can spend in-game currency. In the Main Menu, go to My Club > Squad, select the player, and access their menu. Choose the option “Recover Energy” and confirm the action. 

[h3]In-match substitution: [/h3]
To rebuild a player’s energy during a match, access the Tactics menu by pressing the select button. Press SELECT on the player you’d like to swap out. Confirm your choice, then select the player you’d like to substitute in. Note that players must be substituted during a pause in the match.

By following these steps, you can manage your team’s energy levels like a pro. 

Game on!

notes.title: Getting Started in UFL: The Transfer Market
notes.notes:
UFL’s Transfer Market lets you continuously tweak and improve your squad by adding and selling players. This article will tell you how to navigate the process efficiently and easily. 

[h3]Accessing the Transfer Market:[/h3]
To get to the Transfer Market, navigate to the “Transfers” section within the “Market” sub-tab. 

[h3]Searching for players:[/h3]
You can use filters to help refine your search, sorting by best match to your Squad Synergy (see Episode 6), or by searching for specific criteria to find exactly the player you’re looking for. 

[h3]Further refining your search:
[/h3][*] Sort the search results by footballer rating, position, or name. 
[*] Set the minimum and maximum rating of the desired footballer (ranging from 55-99). 
[*] Try excluding unavailable players, players who are already in your club, or free agents from your search results. 
[*] Set min and max price of players you’re interested in. 

[h3]If you’re looking for a specific footballer, you can try some or all of these steps:[/h3]
[*] Choose the desired player’s real-life position
[*] Start typing the desired player’s first or last name

[h3]Exploring player details:[/h3]
You can see a player’s comprehensive details. 

[h3]Comparing players:[/h3]
You can compare two players by using the comparison option. Browse your squad and select the players you want to compare. 

[h3]Acquiring a new player:[/h3]
To purchase a player, simply press the quick purchase button while the player is selected. If you don’t have any free spots in your squad, you’ll need to purchase a free spot to proceed. 

There you have it! That’s the basics of navigating UFL’s Transfer Market. Trading players helps you bolster your squad with top talent and enhance performance. Good luck out there!

notes.title: Getting Started in UFL: How to Set Up Your Club
notes.notes:
Before you can start scoring goals, you need to create your own club. This guide will take you through the simple process of creating and setting up your own custom football club. 

First, you need to choose a unique name and three-character abbreviation. Both of these will appear on the HUD during your matches. 

Next, browse through the available players and choose a captain for your club. Players with high stats and performance rates make the best captains. Once you’ve found the ideal captain, confirm your choice. 

After choosing your captain, you must set your team’s default formation. UFL offers three classic formations to choose from: 

4-4-2:  This formation plays four defenders, four midfielders, and two forwards. 

5-3-2: This formation’s five defenders (three in the centre, two on the wings) and three midfielders give you an extra boost against attacking teams. Two forwards round out the formation. 

4-3-3: Four defenders, three midfielders, and three forwards make this formation best suited for a possession-focused play style. 

Once you’ve chosen your preferred formation, you’ll see a chart that displays your club’s basic game plan. Players will be assigned to their positions based on their real-life play preferences, with the captain replacing a player in the default squad. 

Finally, you’ll have a chance to confirm all your choices before you finalise the club creation process. You’re ready for kickoff!
